description: Headless browser render any public URL with JavaScript executed in sandboxed Chromium: returns rendered HTML (up to 200,000 chars), visible text, title, headings, and links (or Markdown). $0.003 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for terms, then call again with `payment`.

format.description: Optional output format: both (default HTML + text), html, text, or markdown.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to render in headless Chrome.

waitMs.description: Optional post-load JS settle wait in ms (0-3000, default 1200).

name: browser_render
title: Browser render
